Retain syscall reports in Actions artifacts

The local syscall lanes omitted original reports from their Actions
artifacts, requiring separate downloads for every log and XML file.
Enable the existing bounded report capture for ordinary, KVM and resume
profiles, with command and source records named for the selected lane.

Record cleanup and source-integrity errors as capture failures. Preserve
a known native failure when report capture also fails, and fail otherwise
successful work when its evidence is incomplete.

Assisted-by: Codex
